# ControlMesh: T3 Code workspace

The default application is the unmodified, pinned T3 Code Server/Web. `npm start` launches it; `cm` and `cm t3 ...` transparently use the selected runtime. T3 owns threads, providers, Git, remote connections and durable runtime state. CM adds independent verification, not another agent loop or memory service.

## Read progressively

- [Project intent](PROJECT.md)
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Install and operate T3](docs/installation.md)
- [Verify existing results and remote delivery](docs/verify.md)

## Explicit compatibility only

- [Existing external CLI tasks](docs/agent-link-subagents.md)
- [Execute one external command](docs/run.md)
- [SpecMesh handoff](docs/workflows/small-change.md)
- [Committed-reference synchronization](docs/closeout.md)

A T3 turn ending is not task acceptance. `cm verify` executes selected checks, observes artifacts and binds evidence to the inspected source; optional remote proof observes the real branch. It never invokes an Agent or pushes changes. Waiting-process termination does not cancel an existing T3 thread.

SpecMesh supplies project intent and constraints. Memory storage, recall, maintenance and host injection belong entirely to [AgentTraceMesh's optional plugin](https://github.com/qiaoqiao2521/AgentTraceMesh/blob/main/docs/memory-plugin.md), alongside historical compression, purification and gap retrieval. Hosts use that independent plugin directly; CM has no context proxy, memory injection parameters or receipt forwarding. Plugin source, tests and maintenance live in AgentTraceMesh. The move retains existing data directories, companion identities and record formats; it does not replace a user's installed plugin.

Ordinary tasks do not require all Mesh tools, handoff bundles or extra approvals. T3 project actions require import and are not automatic per-turn hooks.

Companion memory is maintained in AgentTraceMesh. Its former CM source, along with the retired callback and dispatch skill, remains traceable through [fixed history links](docs/retired-components.md). Source retirement does not migrate running services or delete personal state.
